reference.usedFor: single-lever silhouette, compact rounded valve body, knurled spout union, short hooked outlet, inlet-neck hanging point
reference.assumptions: Exact manufacturer, vintage, dimensions, plating condition and valve internals cannot be established from the photo. Dimensions are original modeling assumptions constrained by the existing G13-scale owner; not a replica of a historical SKU.

manufactureInstallation.mounting: Wall-mounted through existing inlet-axis datum. Soap-net accessory loops around the inlet neck behind the body. Wall substrate/fitting behind escutcheon is outside this asset.
manufactureInstallation.interfaces: Knurled union overlaps body-side packing; open annular outlet sleeve provides a real central cavity. Lever is separate from spindle/hub as a manufactured assembly. Component overlaps at joints are intentional; boolean union and pressure sealing are not simulated.
manufactureInstallation.orientationExposure: Wall mounted, Y-up; handle/top and spout receive sun/hand contact, body underside receives splash/runoff. Scene-specific sun direction and moisture exposure remain unverified.
manufactureInstallation.agingCausality: User photo shows a used exterior faucet. Refinement uses higher body roughness and fine wipe/machining normal variation; no baked directional highlights, arbitrary rust patches or fake shadowing.
manufactureInstallation.geometryVsMaterial: Rounded body, single lever, union teeth, outlet cavity, gaskets and seals are geometry. Fine scratches/roughness are material maps.
